name: Commerzbank PSD2 Open Banking API
description: Commerzbank PSD2-compliant Open Banking APIs implementing the Berlin Group NextGenPSD2 XS2A Framework v1.3.11. Provides Account Information Service (AIS), Payment Initiation Service (PIS), Funds Confirmation Service (FCS), and OAuth2 authorization endpoints for third-party providers (TPPs).
